🎬 Dinner with the Parents (2024)

Dinner with the Parents follows the hilarious and dysfunctional Langer family, whose weekly Friday night dinners turn into chaotic gatherings filled with embarrassing situations, ridiculous arguments, and unexpected disasters. At the center of the family are brothers David and Gregg, who regularly return to their parents’ home hoping to enjoy a normal evening but instead find themselves caught in increasingly outrageous situations. Their parents, Harvey and Jane, have their own unusual personalities and complicated relationship, often making family gatherings even more unpredictable. From awkward conversations and uncomfortable romantic encounters to shocking misunderstandings, sibling rivalries, and bizarre family traditions, every dinner becomes an unforgettable experience that tests everyone’s patience. As David struggles with his personal life and Gregg frequently adds to the chaos, the family discovers that even the simplest gathering can spiral completely out of control. Despite their constant disagreements, embarrassing secrets, and ridiculous behavior, the Langers remain connected through their complicated but loving relationships. Combining outrageous comedy, awkward family humor, memorable characters, and unpredictable situations, the series explores sibling rivalry, marriage, parenting, family loyalty, and the hilarious realities of spending time with the people who know you best.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 5.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Developer: Jon Beckerman

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Freevee, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
